SELECT ADM_LOGIN_HIST_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO ADM_LOGIN_HIST ( HIST_SEQ, USER_SEQ, LOGIN_ID, USER_NM, RESULT_CD, RESULT_MSG, SESSION_ID, CLIENT_IP, USER_AGENT, LOGIN_AT, CREATED_AT, CREATED_BY ) VALUES ( #{hist_seq,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{user_seq,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{login_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{user_nm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{result_cd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{result_msg,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{session_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{client_ip,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{user_agent,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, NVL(#{created_by,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'SYSTEM') )

SELECT ADM_LOGIN_SESN_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO ADM_LOGIN_SESN ( SESN_SEQ, SESSION_ID, USER_SEQ, LOGIN_ID, USER_NM, STATUS_CD, CLIENT_IP, USER_AGENT, LOGIN_AT, LAST_ACCESS_AT, EXPIRES_AT, CREATED_AT, CREATED_BY, UPDATED_AT, UPDATED_BY ) VALUES ( #{sesn_seq,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{session_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{user_seq,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{login_id,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{user_nm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{status_cd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{client_ip,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{user_agent,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{login_at,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{last_access_at,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{expires_at,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, SYSTIMESTAMP, NVL(#{created_by,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'SYSTEM'), SYSTIMESTAMP, NVL(#{updated_by,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'SYSTEM') )
mapper.update: UPDATE ADM_LOGIN_SESN SET LAST_ACCESS_AT = #{accessedAt}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE SESSION_ID = #{sessionId} AND STATUS_CD = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE ADM_LOGIN_SESN SET STATUS_CD = #{statusCd}, LOGOUT_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, UPDATED_BY = NVL(#{actor}, 'SYSTEM') WHERE SESSION_ID = #{sessionId} AND STATUS_CD = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE ADM_LOGIN_SESN SET STATUS_CD = #{statusCd}, LOGOUT_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, UPDATED_BY = NVL(#{actor}, 'SYSTEM') WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId} AND STATUS_CD = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT SESSION_ID, STATUS_CD, EXPIRES_AT, USER_SEQ, LOGIN_ID, USER_NM FROM ADM_LOGIN_SESN WHERE SESSION_ID = #{sessionId}

SELECT SESN_SEQ, SESSION_ID, USER_SEQ, LOGIN_ID, USER_NM, STATUS_CD, CLIENT_IP, USER_AGENT, TO_CHAR(LOGIN_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS LOGIN_AT, TO_CHAR(LAST_ACCESS_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS LAST_ACCESS_AT, TO_CHAR(EXPIRES_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS EXPIRES_AT, TO_CHAR(LOGOUT_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS LOGOUT_AT, CASE WHEN STATUS_CD = 'ACTIVE' AND EXPIRES_AT IS NOT NULL AND EXPIRES_AT < SYSTIMESTAMP THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE STATUS_CD END AS VIEW_STATUS_CD FROM ADM_LOGIN_SESN WHERE 1 = 1
AND ( LOGIN_ID LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR NVL(USER_NM, '') LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR NVL(CLIENT_IP, '') LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
AND ( STATUS_CD = 'EXPIRED' OR (STATUS_CD = 'ACTIVE' AND EXPIRES_AT IS NOT NULL AND EXPIRES_AT < SYSTIMESTAMP) )
AND STATUS_CD = #{status_cd}
ORDER BY LOGIN_AT DESC, SESN_SEQ DESC

SELECT HIST_SEQ, USER_SEQ, LOGIN_ID, USER_NM, RESULT_CD, RESULT_MSG, SESSION_ID, CLIENT_IP, USER_AGENT, TO_CHAR(LOGIN_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS LOGIN_AT FROM ADM_LOGIN_HIST WHERE 1 = 1
AND ( LOGIN_ID LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR NVL(USER_NM, '') LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR NVL(CLIENT_IP, '') LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR NVL(RESULT_MSG, '') LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
AND RESULT_CD = #{result_cd}
AND LOGIN_AT >= TO_TIMESTAMP(#{from_dt} || ' 00:00:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND LOGIN_AT < TO_TIMESTAMP(#{to_dt} || ' 23:59:59', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
ORDER BY LOGIN_AT DESC, HIST_SEQ DESC
